CustomField.description: Traffic Light Indicator for Lead Expiry
CustomField.formula: IMAGE( IF( Expiry_Date__c >= TODAY(), CASE( WEEKDAY(TODAY()), 1, IF( Expiry_Date__c = TODAY(), "/img/msg_icons/warning16.png", "/img/samples/flag_green.gif"), 7, IF( Expiry_Date__c = TODAY(), "/img/msg_icons/warning16.png", "/img/samples/flag_green.gif"), 6, IF( Expiry_Date__c <= TODAY() + 3, "/img/msg_icons/warning16.png", "/img/samples/flag_green.gif"), IF( Expiry_Date__c <= TODAY() + 1, "/img/msg_icons/warning16.png", "/img/samples/flag_green.gif")), CASE( WEEKDAY(TODAY()), 1, IF( Expiry_Date__c + 2 <= TODAY(), "/img/msg_icons/warning16.png", "/img/msg_icons/error16.png"), 7, IF( Expiry_Date__c + 2 <= TODAY(), "/img/msg_icons/warning16.png", "/img/msg_icons/error16.png"), "/img/msg_icons/error16.png")) ,"Expiry Indicator")
CustomField.label: Expiry Indicator
